findings.fixHint: Avoid duplicated media nodes that can be discovered twice during compilation.

findings.message: GSAP tweens overlap on "#phD" for rotationY between 24.65s and 24.97s.
findings.fixHint: Shorten the earlier tween, move the later tween, or add `overwrite: "auto"`.

findings.message: "#stD" starts hidden, but its gsap.fromTo() makes it visible only in the from-vars and omits opacity/autoAlpha from the destination. Cold render workers restore the hidden authored state, so the encoded element can stay invisible even when sequential snapshots look correct.
findings.fixHint: Add `opacity: 1` (or `autoAlpha: 1`) to the destination vars for "#stD" so every seek path establishes the visible end state explicitly.

findings.message: Relative value(s) y: "-=170" on "#dm1, #dm2" start while another writer for the same property is active between 27.63s and 27.72s. Relative tweens capture their base at tween init: the sequential path inits mid-flight of the other writer, a cold render worker landing later inits with its end state, so the same frame renders at two different positions (snap at chunk boundaries).
findings.fixHint: Use absolute values for y, or a fromTo() with explicit endpoints, so every seek path resolves the same state. Single-writer relative values are safe; the conflict is the second writer.
